besluite.fout: Relative 'waarom' (around which) is easily read as 'why' by a Grade 6 reader, so the sentence makes them stumble.
besluite.rede: Splitting the sentence keeps the same meaning (the axis is a line through its middle that it turns around) and removes the stumble.
'Reis in sy wentelbaan' is natural, idiomatic Afrikaans; 'langs' is a lateral preposition swap with no gain.
'Jy sien elke keer' reads naturally in context; the proposal only lengthens the sentence and adds a pronoun.

besluite.fout: 'Teen die tyd dat' copies English 'by the time', and 'terug is' leaves where the learner returns to unsaid.
besluite.rede: 'Wanneer jy weer by jou beginplek is' is natural Afrikaans, clearer, and keeps the meaning and the following clause intact.

besluite.fout: 'Sou ons in een reis om die Aarde' leaves unclear who travels and can read as if we do.
besluite.rede: The proposal makes the Moon the traveller with an unambiguous 'hy', without changing what is claimed.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Ons sien' / 'daarom weet ons').
besluite.rede: Required comma; matches the comma already used in 'Die Maan wentel om die Aarde, en die twee reis'.

besluite.fout: 'Herhaal' is transitive in standard Afrikaans and needs the reflexive pronoun here.
besluite.rede: Adding the reflexive 'hulle' supplies a word the grammar requires without touching the number or the meaning.
This subject writes 'Sonnestelsel' with a capital in every lesson in running text, so it must not be lowercased.
'Terugbons' is the subject's decided word, as in the shared definition of 'weerkaats', and must not be replaced.
